author: Bellular News
description:
Bobby Kotick is back in games, with a seat on Skydance's board and WB Games now under its roof. There are huge franchises on the table, but years of failed projects and studio closures behind them. Will gaming finally get the backing it needs, or be first in line for cuts when the merger gets expensive?

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
